boundaries.title: Ethical Agreements
boundaries.description: Agreements that protect the autonomy of early-career professionals.

items.question: Who sets the agenda?
items.answer: You retain full agency. Session content remains strictly confidential per ICF standards, even if third parties provide sponsorship.

items.question: How is progress measured?
items.answer: Through the acquisition of objective data points from behavioral experiments.

items.question: Transition stress?
items.answer: Coaching is not therapy. We will signpost clinical support if needs fall outside the coaching scope.

cases.title: Case Studies
cases.description: Illustrating professional transition pathways for early-career individuals.

items.title: Sector Exploration
items.context: Graduate facing decision paralysis between three distinct industry pathways.
items.coaching_moves: Developed a decision matrix and prototyped informational interviews to gather objective sector data.
items.shift: Defined a selection rationale based on long-term value and a 6-month development plan.

items.title: Onboarding Alignment
items.context: Early-career professional seeking to establish regular feedback loops.
items.coaching_moves: Practiced output-linked feedback scripts and identified internal support networks.
items.shift: Established a recurring feedback rhythm, improving role clarity and performance alignment.
